title: Both born under Neptune–Pluto in Sagittarius
plain: The slow cycle between Neptune and Pluto was passing through Sagittarius when both of you were born.
reading: These are generational rhythms — they change over decades, not days, so this says the two of you belong to the same long season of history. It is the part of the reading that is about your era as much as about you.

title: Pluto in Pisces, in the composite chart
plain: In the composite chart — the midpoint of the two birth charts, read as the chart of the relationship itself, Pluto sits in Pisces.
reading: Pluto is depth, power and the things that transform a person. Pisces is mercy and dissolving.

title: Pluto in Pisces, in the Davison chart
plain: In the Davison chart — a real chart cast for the exact midpoint in time between the two births, so the relationship gets a birthday of its own, Pluto sits in Pisces.
reading: Pluto is depth, power and the things that transform a person. Pisces is mercy and dissolving.

title: His Jupiter challenges her Venus
plain: Laying his birth chart over hers, his Jupiter and her Venus sit 90° apart — friction that forces both people to grow.
reading: His Jupiter is generosity, faith, growth and good fortune. Her Venus is love, affection, beauty and what someone treasures. Synastry reads this contact as one of the live wires between two people.

title: Same phase 23 of the Neptune–Pluto cycle
plain: Divide the Neptune–Pluto cycle into 36 parts; both births fall in part 23.
reading: A generational marker: it moves over decades, so it speaks to the age you were both born into.

title: Same phase 15 of the Neptune–Pluto cycle
plain: Divide the Neptune–Pluto cycle into 24 parts; both births fall in part 15.
reading: A generational marker: it moves over decades, so it speaks to the age you were both born into.

title: His Saturn flows with her Sun
plain: Laying his birth chart over hers, his Saturn and her Sun sit 120° apart — the easiest angle in astrology, help given freely.
reading: His Saturn is duty, endurance, patience and the weight of time. Her Sun is who someone is at the core — vitality, pride, the will to shine. Synastry reads this contact as one of the live wires between two people.

title: His Venus flows with her Venus, in the 5th harmonic
plain: Multiply every position in both charts by 5 and read the result. In that chart his Venus and her Venus sit 120° apart — the easiest angle in astrology, help given freely.
reading: The 5th harmonic is the creative chart — what two people make together. His Venus is love, affection, beauty and what someone treasures; her Venus is love, affection, beauty and what someone treasures.

title: Guna Milan score 24–27 out of 36
plain: The eight traditional compatibility tests, scored and added: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot and Nadi.
reading: This is the number a Vedic astrologer actually gives a couple. Eighteen of thirty-six is the classical threshold for a match; the high twenties is considered a strong one.

title: Jupiter in Cancer, in the composite chart
plain: In the composite chart — the midpoint of the two birth charts, read as the chart of the relationship itself, Jupiter sits in Cancer.
reading: Jupiter is generosity, faith, growth and good fortune. Cancer is home and safekeeping.

title: His gana Rakshasa, hers Manushya
plain: His birth star is Rakshasa, hers is Manushya.
reading: Gana is temperament — his fierce — wilful and intense, hers human — practical and mixed.

title: The star-count between the two birth stars
plain: Counting from his birth star to hers and back again gives the Tara pair.
reading: Tara is read for fortune between the two — some counts are auspicious, and the 3rd, 5th and 7th are the ones the tradition warns about.

title: His nadi Madhya, hers Madhya
plain: His birth star falls in the Madhya nadi, hers in the Madhya nadi.
reading: Nadi is the constitutional pulse. Both of you carry Pitta — fire and drive. Different nadis score the full eight points; the same nadi scores nothing.

title: His Pluto meets her Pluto
plain: Laying his birth chart over hers, his Pluto and her Pluto sit at the same degree — the two energies fuse and amplify each other.
reading: Pluto is depth, power and the things that transform a person — and this angle links his to hers. Synastry reads this contact as one of the live wires between two people.

title: Nadi dosha — the same pulse
plain: Both birth stars fall in the same nadi, so the koota scores zero of eight.
reading: Nadi is the constitutional pulse. Sharing it is the single heaviest caution in Guna Milan — traditionally read as too much sameness rather than too little. It is also the one most often waived when the rest of the chart is strong.

title: The same birth element
plain: Both birth years carry the same element.
reading: Shared element is read as easy understanding with little friction to grow on.

title: His Uranus meets her Uranus
plain: Laying his birth chart over hers, his Uranus and her Uranus sit at the same degree — the two energies fuse and amplify each other.
reading: Uranus is freedom, surprise and the urge to break the pattern — and this angle links his to hers. Synastry reads this contact as one of the live wires between two people.
